name: ARK: Survival Evolved Dedicated Server
description: Install the ARK: Survival Evolved dedicated server through SteamCMD and launch its native server binary directly without a shell.
known_limitations: GameNode manages selected ServerSettings values through a bounded sectioned INI adapter. Advanced gameplay, mod, cluster, BattlEye, and other INI settings remain unmanaged.
The adapter targets the generated WindowsServer configuration; Linux ASE configuration remains documented only because adapter targets are currently not platform-specific.
GameNode uses bounded native termination. ARK's save-on-shutdown behavior is not claimed as a guaranteed graceful stop.
Automatic updates, mod installation, cluster orchestration, and update-on-start are outside this template. SteamCMD updates are explicit through GameNode's Update Server action.

variables.name: Map
variables.description: Map identifier passed to the dedicated server. The default is TheIsland.

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: Name shown in the ARK server browser.

variables.name: Game port
variables.description: UDP port for ARK game traffic.

variables.name: Query port
variables.description: UDP query port used by the server browser.

variables.name: Admin password
variables.description: Optional password for ARK administrator commands.

variables.name: PvE mode
variables.description: Disable PvP and run the server in PvE mode.

variables.name: RCON port
variables.description: TCP port used by ARK RCON when enabled.

requirements.description: Managed anonymous SteamCMD installation is required.
The reviewed ARK dedicated-server builds target x86-64 hosts.
Ensure sufficient storage for the current server build, saves, and optional mods.

help.summary: GameNode installs SteamCMD App ID 376030 and launches the platform-specific ARK server binary directly.
notes: Forward the registered UDP game and query ports.
Advanced settings belong in the generated platform-specific INI files; GameNode does not rewrite them.
The map variable uses ARK's map identifier, not a filesystem path.

findings.summary: Advanced ARK settings, passwords, mods, cluster configuration, and BattlEye are documented but not managed by a compiled GameNode adapter.
GameNode uses bounded native termination and does not claim that ARK will always save before termination.

prerequisites: Network access to Steam content servers during installation
An amd64 Windows or Linux host
Sufficient storage for server files and world saves
